name: Portal HTTP API
consumers: SV-007; SV-009; a host website's page
definition: ANY /api/{proxy+} behind CloudFront and the origin secret: GET collections, status, summary, ontology, entities, entity, passage, graph, neighbourhood, paths, drafts, draft, table, document, chat, usage, requests; POST chat (202 and a job id), requests
versioning: With the release; no version in the path
notes: A Cognito JWT authoriser on the route, or the site grant verified by the Lambda. Drafts and requests for private callers only

name: Graph tools over MCP
consumers: SV-002; a consumer's own MCP front
definition: list_collections, describe_ontology, search_entities, list_entities, get_entity, neighbourhood, find_paths, describe_structured, lookup_rows, aggregate; schema-graph.json generated from the code
versioning: With the release; the schema is uploaded by Terraform
notes: caller_private is written by the interceptor; a call without it is public

name: Passage tools over MCP
definition: search_passages (query, collection, limit), read_passages (up to ten ids); schema-passages.json
notes: Vector through the Knowledge Base or keyword fallback; the method is returned

name: Agent invocation
definition: POST /invocations with a bearer token and a session id header; payload question, collection, history, mode, about, stream; the result or server-sent events of steps then the result
versioning: With the release; the Runtime endpoint may be pinned to a version
notes: The portal has no IAM grant to invoke; the call is authorised by the token

name: Upload and build events
definition: Object created under landing/ or ending in ontology/active.json to the uploads queue, a Pipe and RunTask; object created under the build bucket's source/ to both image builds
notes: A dead-letter queue after five receives

name: Ontology version renditions
consumers: SV-002; SV-004; SV-001 (extraction and load); any consumer of the version
definition: ontology/versions/<v>/: ontology.ttl, shapes.ttl, manifest.json with checksums, renditions owl, agent (md and json), neo4j (cypher, mapping, md), age (sql), extraction (tool.json), jsonld (context), structured (mapping.json), r2rml (mapping.ttl)
versioning: Semver per collection; immutable once published
notes: Consumers read a rendition, never the master

name: Core vocabulary ks:
definition: https://w3id.org/knowledge-store/core, version 1.1.0: Document, Passage, ExtractionRun, Assertion, Cell and their properties; core SHACL shapes
versioning: Semver with git tags core-v<version>; version IRIs resolve to the tag
notes: Code may name core terms and never a domain term

name: Mapping and metrics files
definition: mappings.yaml: tables with location, logical_table, class, key, scope, columns as attribute or relation; metrics.osi.yaml in the OSI v1.0 shape with a read-only SELECT
notes: Checked at publish against the ontology

name: Evaluation set format
definition: YAML: collection, questions with id, question, kind, must, must_not, first, sources, answerable, private

name: Terraform module inputs and outputs
definition: including a host deployment's own repository
versioning: infra/modules/knowledge-store: admin_email, name, collections, discovery, extraction_workers, schedule, llm_provider, model ids, portal_title, branding, admin_private, daily_questions, api_throttle, portal_web_acl_arn, force_destroy_lake, knowledge_graph, knowledge_base, agent, guardrail, valves, budget, network, portal_domain, site_sign_in, permissions_boundary, log_retention_days; outputs portal_url, lake_bucket, upload_to, image_build_project, run_now, pipeline_logs, cognito_user_pool, cognito_client_id, agent, knowledge_graph, knowledge_base, evaluate, provided_ontologies, sign_in
notes: A release tag the consumer pins (ref=vX.Y.Z)
column9: A deployment moves its pin to a release, never to a commit

name: Site grant
definition: X-Site-Grant: an ES256 JWT with kid, iss, aud lab:<lab>, exp, sub, roles; verified against configured JWKS; roles mapped to read and private read
column11: The portal verifies and never mints

name: Cognito tokens groups and scopes
definition: Access token claims sub, cognito:groups (private-readers), scope (<name>/agent.invoke, tools.public, tools.private); the web client and two service clients
notes: The chat page sends the access token

name: Source adapter entry point
definition: Entry point group knowledge_store.adapters; a class with type, items() and fetch(item) over SourceConfig and the lake Store

name: Command line
definition: knowledge-store run, ingest, refine, extract, project, discover, ontology (versions, active, pull, diff, publish, activate, render), candidates, status, collections; python -m knowledge_store.ledger report; python -m knowledge_store.evals; python -m knowledge_store.portal_api.local

name: Lake layout
consumers: SV-002; SV-003; SV-004; SV-005; the Knowledge Base role
definition: layout.py: landing/, collections/<id>/{config, bronze, silver, gold/<v>, ontology, portal, manifests, usage}, kb/passages, locks, config; pointers gold/{graph,documents,sparql,kb}.json
notes: A contract because the tool Lambdas read it without the ontology parser

name: Chat page configuration and embed protocol
definition: config.json: mode local, hosted (cognito domain, clientId, redirectUri) or site (origin, lab); the postMessage protocol pn:hello, pn:init, pn:ready, pn:grant between the host and the framed page
notes: frame-ancestors names the host and the portal in site mode
